out_of_scope: I can only answer questions about the three Digital Expansion Initiative documents (Project Overview, Budget & Timeline, Team & Governance). For example: "What is the total project budget?"
greeting: Hello! I answer questions about the three Digital Expansion Initiative documents: the Project Overview, the Budget & Timeline Breakdown, and the Team & Governance Document. Every answer cites the document, page and section.
not_in_documents: The three documents don't provide this information.
clarify_fallback: Could you say a little more about what you mean?
error: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.
budget_exhausted: Today's usage limit for this prototype has been reached. Please try again tomorrow.
turn_cap: This conversation has reached its message limit. Please start a new conversation.
too_long: Your message is too long. Please keep it under 1,000 characters.
partial_removed: Part of the answer could not be verified against the documents and was removed.
partial_unstated: The documents don't cover every part of the question.
injection_refused: I can't change how I work. I only answer from the three Digital Expansion Initiative documents, and every answer cites its sources. Please ask a question about the documents, for example: "What is the total project budget?"
